prompt:

- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Character Stage Full Bleed Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a full-bleed interactive stage highlighting high-detail pet previews. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a median 89s, indicating drop-off during selection.)
1: [home, new_flow] Pet Care Activity mini-flow during Wait: Introduces an interactive companion setup activity screen during pet generation waiting period. (why: The home wait step takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, creating drop-off risks while waiting for generation.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Pick Friend Before Sign-In Sequence Shift: Moves the sign-in step after initial pet pick so users build emotional commitment before authentication. (why: Sign in step drops conversion to 72.9%, and letting users pick their pet first increases intent to save progress.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Audio Alert When Generation Completes: Adds an optional sound notification trigger on the waiting screen when companion generation finishes. (why: Home wait mean time is 2336s, showing users leave the desktop screen while background generation finishes.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Protection Clear Benefit Copy: Updates headline and body to emphasize cloud backup and pet state preservation. (why: 8 users emailed about lost pets after re-login; clear messaging sets correct sign-in expectations.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Trait Exploration Screen: Inserts a feature exploration screen right after choose_path detailing companion abilities. (why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users, and median time is only 8s, indicating rushed or uncertain choices.)
